head.lede: This structure exists to answer that honestly.

p: The one-way direction matters: the matrix reads the taxonomy, and never the reverse. A code review rule says so outright:

p.b: variant support must not be inferred from a related family name.

body: Ship a rule list. A credential nobody wrote a rule for simply is not mentioned.

body.b: You cannot tell “we checked and do not catch it” apart from “we never thought about it”.

body: Lists the gaps in the same table as the wins, each with its reason.
